title: feat(full-core): ratify current-productive account-equity source architecture
body:
## Summary
- Ratifies `CURRENT_PRODUCTIVE_ACCOUNT_EQUITY_MODEL_V1` as a four-layer architecture: account-equity stock, venue `eq` as reconciliation target only, `RUNNING_ACCOUNT_EQUITY_AVAILABLE_FOR_SIZING` as the STEP-29P consumer input, and sealed legacy reconstruction off the live-critical path.
- Binds today's 29P/pre-wire consumer graph without selecting a source, minting values, uplifting `eq`, or reopening the sealed CQ census. U04 remains available-for-sizing, not equity stock.
- Names the current live-critical blocker `CURRENT_PRODUCTIVE_AVAILABLE_FOR_SIZING_SOURCE_UNBOUND`. No Live/Canary/POST, no enable/arm, no merge.

## Test plan
- [x] Owner tests: `tests/ops/test_full_core_current_productive_account_equity_source_architecture_v1.py` plus CQ non-regression
- [x] PR_BOUNDED_FULL selector targets plus 29P/U04 related tests (769 passed, ~41s)
- [x] Docs token policy, docs-reference-targets `--changed`, docs-drift-guard
- [x] Canonical evidence manifest verify `RC=0`
- [ ] GitHub required checks on this PR (confirmation only; do not merge)
